scope: One-off native path and psychrometric design review of casing seam sealing. This is not a measured leak rate, adhesion, lifetime, or complete vapor-retarder qualification; it adds no recurring check.
customer_outcome: Keep humid cabinet air out of chilled component spaces and preserve dry insulation during refrigerated operation.
decision: Seal the top shell/cap seam for refrigerated operation with the specified exterior 3M 425 band. Cap/lid joints close the separate cap insulation cavities; the same end bands cover these. The bottom shell/cap joint is between printed floors and has no equivalent direct opening to the body insulation. Covering it is incidental to the common lower band. Room-temperature enclosure fit prints do not require the tape.
placement_basis: foam_assembly.build(): top cup floor at shell top + 0.15 mm, top lid at shell top + 14.6 mm, both rotated 180 degrees about Z. Body foam is assumed flush-trimmed at shell top. The connected three-segment witness enters the intact +X side-wall joint at Y=20 mm, avoiding the copper slots and screw axes, and approaches the negative-X side of the outlet tube.

continuous_line_clearance_review.route: outside through upper side-wall joint, clear of copper slots and screw axes
across seat to chilled outlet, clear of other top conduits

path_limit: Native part clearance establishes a design opening, not its as-printed flow conductance. Clamping can close nominal allowances; dry printed contact has no specified continuous air seal. The outlet tube is a candidate condensation surface during cold-water dispensing; its exterior temperature is not measured here.
psychrometric_method: Hyland-Wexler water saturation pressure in SI (ASHRAE Fundamentals 2017, ch. 1 eq. 6). Dew point is the bisection solution of p_ws(T_dew)=RH*p_ws(T_air), neglecting the small humid-air enhancement factor.

material_basis.foam: Fiberglass Supply Depot describes its 2 lb foam as 95-98% closed cell and water resistant, with possible water uptake under prolonged submersion. Its product page does not supply a vapor-permeance qualification at the cold-core thickness. Closed cells do not close an external joint or a conduit annulus.
material_basis.tape: 3M 425 technical data lists moisture barriers in appliances, low moisture-vapor transmission, 0.12 mm total thickness, and clean/dry above-freezing application. These support the local static-seam use; its reported WVTR is not an installed-system permeance or lifetime result.

boundary_scope: The end bands seal the casing perimeter only. The nine top tube/cable annuli, copper-slot exits, screw access and exposed cap foam at pour/vent holes are separate parts of the warm-side moisture boundary. Reservoir vent membranes, tube lumens and the PRV discharge route must remain functional. No complete vapor-retarder claim follows from the seam bands.
witness_other_conduits: The first segment is at shell Y=20 mm, clear of the nearest reed conduit center at Y=31 mm and fluid conduit centers at |Y| >=43.5 mm. The second segment is at X=-55.7 mm, clear of their axes. The final segment is 3.5 mm from the outlet axis, between the 3.25 mm measured tube radius and 3.75 mm bore radius.
